candidate_classes.label: Bounded-return delayed-gate subclass
candidate_classes.one_line_definition: Stationary delayed-return local-domain families with explicit gate/hold/return structure and bounded checked return regime.
candidate_classes.frontier_value: Best conservative next theorem class: better than trivial induced collapse but still directly supported by the frozen witness data.
candidate_classes.proof_outlook: Most realistic next target because it only needs bounded-return induction plus truncation control, not a full countable-state theory.

candidate_classes.label: Finite-state renewal local-domain subclass
candidate_classes.one_line_definition: Local-domain families whose induced coding is nontrivial but remains effectively finite-state renewal-like.
candidate_classes.frontier_value: Useful reserve if delayed-return evidence fails to widen beyond renewal-like behavior.
candidate_classes.proof_outlook: Probably easier than the stretch class, but less valuable if the delayed-return structure can already be isolated directly.

candidate_classes.label: Countable-state delayed-return local-domain class
candidate_classes.one_line_definition: Delayed-return local-domain families with genuinely growing induced return structure not reducible to a small finite-state renewal model.
candidate_classes.frontier_value: Real frontier target if the delayed-return witnesses can be shown to keep growing induced structure beyond the checked cap.
candidate_classes.proof_outlook: High-value stretch class, but currently blocked by lack of structural evidence beyond finite-cap diagnostics.
